name: procps

commands.command:
chown -R tester .
su tester -c "PATH=$PATH make check"

description: The Procps-ng package contains programs for monitoring processes.

installed_descriptions.name: free
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the amount of free and used memory (both physical and swap memory) in the system

installed_descriptions.name: pgrep
installed_descriptions.description: Looks up processes based on their name and other attributes

installed_descriptions.name: pidof
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the PIDs of the given programs

installed_descriptions.name: pkill
installed_descriptions.description: Signals processes based on their name and other attributes

installed_descriptions.name: pmap
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the memory map of the given process

installed_descriptions.name: pwdx
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the current working directory of a process

installed_descriptions.name: slabtop
installed_descriptions.description: Displays detailed kernel slab cache information in real time

installed_descriptions.name: sysctl
installed_descriptions.description: Modifies kernel parameters at run time

installed_descriptions.name: tload
installed_descriptions.description: Prints a graph of the current system load average

installed_descriptions.name: top
installed_descriptions.description: Displays a list of the most CPU intensive processes; it provides an ongoing look at processor activity in real time

installed_descriptions.name: uptime
installed_descriptions.description: Reports how long the system has been running, how many users are logged on, and the system load averages

installed_descriptions.name: vmstat
installed_descriptions.description: Reports virtual memory statistics, giving information about processes, memory, paging, block Input/Output (IO), traps, and CPU activity

installed_descriptions.name: w
installed_descriptions.description: Shows which users are currently logged on, where, and since when

installed_descriptions.name: watch
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a given command repeatedly, displaying the first screen-full of its output; this allows a user to watch the output change over time

installed_descriptions.name: libproc-2
installed_descriptions.description: Contains the functions used by most programs in this package
